none: PAS FindID 1009071: copper alloy Roman radiate possibly of Tetricus II
contea di ritrovamento: Wakefield (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper alloy Roman radiate possibly of Tetricus II (AD 271-274), Reece Period 13. Possibly PRINCEPS IUVENT reverse type. Unclear mint. Obverse description: Bust facing right. Obverse inscription: Illegible. Reverse description: The Prince as Leader of Youth holding spear. Reverse inscription: Illegible. Coin measures: 23.50 mm in diameter, 1.66 mm in thickness, and 3.97g in weight
